**Claim:** `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8234-scroll-area-content-rows`

PM dispatch. Assignee and this claim are set by the PM seat for the dev seat; the dev inherits both and posts no second claim.

## Re-verified on today's `main` `0fa7a9c83` (card measured `f57ca757b`)

Both of the card's claims hold:

- `content/docs/components/complex/scroll-area.mdx:39` publishes `content?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[];  // Scrollable content` — and `ScrollAreaSchema` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts:505`) declares no such member.
- `:40` labels `children?` as `// Alternative content prop`, while `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/scroll-area.tsx:34` is `renderChildren(schema.children)` — the **single** content read in the renderer.

⚠️ **Anchor drift**: the card cites `layout.ts:488-507`; the interface actually opens at **`:505`**. The mdx line numbers `:38-40` happen to be exact. ⛔ Re-derive on your own base and match on text — a line number is a hint about where to look, never an instruction about what to change.

## ⭐ TWO MORE WRONG ROWS on the same page, found while verifying — in scope

The card did not catch these, and they are the same defect class on the same fence:

| mdx | declaration (`packages/types/src/layout.ts`) |
|---|---|
| `:32` `height?: string;` | `:510` `height?: string \| number;` |
| `:33` `width?: string;` | `:514` `width?: string \| number;` |

The page narrows both to `string`. An author following it would believe `height: 200` is invalid when the declaration accepts it. **Fold these in** — it is one page, one fence, one re-derivation, and splitting them would mean a second PR over the same four lines.

⇒ While you are in there, **re-derive the whole fence against the declaration**, not just the rows named here, and report anything else that disagrees. Two of four rows checked were wrong; assume the rest need checking too.

## Landing control — established before any edit

`content/docs/components/complex/scroll-area.mdx`, measured with `grep -cF` (fixed-string — a regex grep reads the `|` as alternation; that has cost this session repeatedly):

| leg | now | required after |
|---|--:|--:|
| `content?: SchemaNode` | **1** | 0 |
| `Alternative content prop` | **1** | 0 |
| `height?: string;` (the narrowed row) | **1** | 0 |
| `width?: string;` | **1** | 0 |
| lit control — `SchemaNode` on any line | **2** | must stay non-zero |

## The judgement left to you

The card asks whether the page's **"Base properties" section (`:45-48`)** is still the right shape. Decide it and argue it in the PR body from the declaration — either answer is fine if reasoned, neither is fine as an unstated default.

⚠️ Note `:47` publishes `visible?: boolean | string | { dialect?: string; source: string }` — check that against `BaseSchema` too while you are deciding.

## ⭐ Precedent to follow — objectui#8197 / PR #8237, landed hours ago

Same defect, same page family, same fence class. Its dev ruled **no row for the inherited optional `children`** on the collapsible page, on the ground that **read-ness, not inheritance, is the discriminator** — and used the repo's existing shape for an unread-but-inherited key (prose below the fence, as `content/docs/components/overlay/tooltip.mdx:24-27` does). ⚠️ Note this page is the **opposite** case: here `children` **is** read, so it is the content channel and belongs in the fence — do not transplant that ruling mechanically.

That PR also demonstrated the deliverable end-to-end rather than by grep (zod `safeParse` refusing the old authoring, a real render probe showing the empty body). **Do the same here if it is cheap** — a `scroll-area` authored per the current page versus the corrected one. If it is not cheap, say so rather than substituting a proxy.

## ⚠️ No gate will confirm this for you

`check:doc-types` reads only `type` string literals from doc code blocks, so it never judges a member row. `check:doc-snippets` compiles only `ts`/`tsx`/`typescript` fences (`TS_FENCE_LANGUAGES` at `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs:548`); this block is `plaintext`, outside its population by construction. ⇒ **your own before/after measurement with a firing control IS the verification.** Run the doc gates and report their verdicts as what they are, but ⛔ do not offer a green CI as evidence for these rows.

## Scope

⛔ objectui#6805 (the scroll-area **demo catalog**) is closed and is not this card — that covered demos, this is the reference page. ⛔ Do not touch `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/scroll-area.tsx`; the renderer is correct, the page is wrong. ⛔ Never `git stash`. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`. Worktree-first.

⛔ Draft PR only — the PM flips and lands. Return the standard structured JSON report, and say bluntly if anything above is wrong; it is a reconstruction and this session has had four corrected by devs already, three of which would have caused damage if followed.
